CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE building_address AS
WITH src AS (
  SELECT building_number, street_number, street_name, street_suffix, city, state, CAST(postal_code AS VARCHAR) AS postal_code
  FROM beaver."FAC_BUILDING_ADDRESS"
  WHERE UPPER(COALESCE(address_purpose,'UNKNOWN')) = 'STREET'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT building_number, street_number, street_name, street_suffix, city, state, CAST(postal_code AS VARCHAR) AS postal_code
  FROM beaver."FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS"
  WHERE UPPER(COALESCE(address_purpose,'UNKNOWN')) = 'STREET'
), ranked AS (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY building_number ORDER BY 1) AS rn
  FROM src
)
SELECT building_number, street_number, street_name, street_suffix, city, state, postal_code
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE rooms_space AS
WITH sd AS (
  SELECT building_key, building_room, room_square_footage
  FROM beaver."SPACE_DETAIL"
), fr AS (
  SELECT CAST(building_key AS VARCHAR) AS building_key_from_fac, room_full_name AS building_room, area, organization_name, CAST(dept_code AS VARCHAR) AS dept_code
  FROM beaver."FAC_ROOMS"
), zpm AS (
  SELECT building_room, CAST(hr_org_unit_id AS BIGINT) AS hr_org_unit_id
  FROM beaver."ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD"
)
SELECT 
  COALESCE(sd.building_key, fr.building_key_from_fac) AS building_key,
  COALESCE(sd.building_room, fr.building_room) AS building_room,
  sd.room_square_footage,
  fr.area,
  zpm.hr_org_unit_id,
  fr.organization_name,
  fr.dept_code
FROM sd
FULL OUTER JOIN fr ON sd.building_room = fr.building_room
LEFT JOIN zpm ON COALESCE(sd.building_room, fr.building_room) = zpm.building_room

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH addr AS (
  SELECT 
    ba.building_number,
    FIRST(ba.street_number) AS street_number,
    FIRST(ba.street_name) AS street_name,
    FIRST(ba.street_suffix) AS street_suffix,
    FIRST(ba.city) AS city,
    FIRST(ba.state) AS state,
    FIRST(CAST(ba.postal_code AS VARCHAR)) AS postal_code
  FROM building_address ba
  GROUP BY ba.building_number
),
rooms_union AS (
  -- unify possible room sqft and hr org
  SELECT 
    rs.building_key,
    COALESCE(z.hr_org_unit_id, rs.hr_org_unit_id) AS hr_org_unit_id,
    COALESCE(rs.room_square_footage, fr.area) AS room_sqft
  FROM rooms_space rs
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT building_room, hr_org_unit_id FROM rooms_space WHERE hr_org_unit_id IS NOT NULL
  ) zmap ON 1=0 -- placeholder no-op to keep structure
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT NULL AS building_key, NULL AS hr_org_unit_id, NULL AS room_sqft
  ) dummy ON 1=0
),
by_building_rooms AS (
  SELECT 
    rs.building_key,
    SUM(COALESCE(rs.room_square_footage, rs.area, 0)) AS total_room_sqft,
    AVG(NULLIF(COALESCE(rs.room_square_footage, rs.area, 0),0)) AS avg_room_sqft,
    COUNT(*) AS room_count
  FROM rooms_space rs
  GROUP BY rs.building_key
),
hr_by_building AS (
  SELECT 
    rs.building_key,
    FIRST(h.hr_department_name) AS hr_department_name

  JOIN hr_org h ON rs.hr_org_unit_id = h.hr_org_unit_id
  GROUP BY rs.building_key
),
base_building AS (

    COALESCE(bm.building_number, fb.building_number) AS building_number,

    CAST(fb.building_height AS DOUBLE) AS building_height,

    COALESCE(bm.bldg_gross_square_footage, fb.ext_gross_area) AS total_sqft,
    bm.building_key
  FROM buildings_master bm
  FULL OUTER JOIN fclt_building fb ON bm.building_number = fb.building_number
),
assembled AS (
  SELECT 
    bb.building_number,
    bb.building_name,
    bb.building_height,
    a.street_number,
    a.street_name,
    a.street_suffix,
    a.city,
    a.state,
    a.postal_code,
    COALESCE(hb.hr_department_name, 'Unknown') AS hr_department_name,
    bb.assignable_sqft,
    bb.total_sqft,
    br.avg_room_sqft
  FROM base_building bb
  LEFT JOIN addr a ON a.building_number = bb.building_number
  LEFT JOIN hr_by_building hb ON hb.building_key = bb.building_key
  LEFT JOIN by_building_rooms br ON br.building_key = bb.building_key
)
SELECT 
  building_name,
  building_number,
  building_height,
  CONCAT_WS(' ', street_number, street_name, street_suffix) AS street_address,
  city,
  state,
  hr_department_name,
  assignable_sqft,
  total_sqft,
  avg_room_sqft
FROM assembled
ORDER BY assignable_sqft DESC NULLS LAST, total_sqft DESC NULLS LAST, avg_room_sqft DESC NULLS LAST
